name: Earbuds
description: TSA rules for earbuds and wireless earphones on planes.

carryOn.reason: Earbuds, earphones, and wireless earbuds (AirPods, etc.) are fully allowed in carry-on bags and can be used during flight.

checkedBag.reason: Earbuds are allowed in checked baggage, though it's best to keep them in carry-on to prevent loss or damage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring earbuds on a plane?

travelTips: Keep earbuds in carry-on to prevent loss
Wireless charging cases with lithium batteries should stay in carry-on

faq.question: Can I bring earbuds on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, earbuds and wireless earphones (including AirPods) are fully allowed in carry-on and checked baggage.

faq.question: Can I use earbuds on the plane?
faq.answer: Yes, earbuds can be used throughout the flight including during takeoff and landing on most airlines.
